friendly_name: Internal link integrity — base-prefix, relative-link & glossary-anchor 404s
purpose_context: The example docsite ships many broken internal links: glossary term links and hand-authored section links omit the /doc-kitty base and 404; relative links on leaf pages resolve as children and 404; glossary term headings render literal {#anchor} text with doubled ids so fragments never resolve; and the link-check gate reports success while all of it is broken. This mission makes internal links resolve and makes the gate fail-closed. Closes #61, #62, #63.
purpose_tldr: Internal links stop 404-ing: glossary terms, section links, and relative links resolve under the site base, and the link gate catches breakage instead of passing it.
